main.description: Reserve a World handle and keys for 24 hours. Service auth must name the owner as issuer and this tenor's did:web service with #motet_tenor as audience. The owner signs the returned PLC genesis on their device; its DID is determined only by that signature.

rotationKey.description: The owner's public P-256 or K-256 did:key, listed first for PLC recovery priority. Never send the private key.

tenorRotationKey.description: Opt in to a tenor-held recovery key listed after the owner's key.

operation.description: Unsigned plc_operation genesis with prev explicitly null.

signingBytes.description: Unpadded base64url of the canonical DAG-CBOR unsigned operation. Sign these bytes with rotationKey.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds; createWorld must begin before this instant.
